release_notes: **Upstox analytics token (optional)**: paste a 1-year read-only token in Settings → Upstox and market data (quotes, candles, margin / charge calculators), the Option Scanner, the live-tick feed and paper mode keep working without the daily login. It cannot place orders — live trading still needs the daily token, and orders now fail fast with a clear message when it's missing. **Upstox automatic login with TOTP (optional, unverified live)**: save your PIN and TOTP secret and the installed app logs in by itself on trading mornings (08:30–08:50 IST) when the token has lapsed; **Login now with TOTP** does it on demand. The development copy never auto-logs in. `UPSTOX_SANDBOX=1` switch plus `tools/upstox_*` sandbox, live read-only and WebSocket probe scripts. **Upstox LIMIT orders were rejected** (`price is required`): `place_order` always sent price 0. Only the MARKET→LIMIT retry set a price, which hid it. Found by the Upstox sandbox run. **Upstox login no longer ends on the ThetaPrime login page**: the callback (which opens in your default browser) now shows a "login done, you can close this tab" page.
